topic: Zeeland Energy Terminal (ZET) — 2025/26 development status, FID timeline, FSRU and operator detail
wiki_text: The Zeeland Energy Terminal (ZET), proposed by VTTI and Höegh Evi (formerly Höegh LNG), advanced through 2025–2026 as a Dutch 'project of national interest'. The permitting process formally launched on 2 May 2025 (Phase II, coordinated by central authorities); a public-feedback window on the draft Scope and Level of Detail ran 12 Dec 2025–22 Jan 2026. An open season opened with an Expression of Interest phase that closed 6 March 2026, with Heads of Agreement targeted around May 2026 and the broader commercial process concluding by end-2026. A final investment decision is expected by Q3 2027, with commercial operations targeted for late 2029 / Q4 2029. The FSRU would be permanently moored at Quarleshaven, Vlissingen-Oost (the secured/preferred site, within the broader Zeeland province location GEM already records), with ~7.5 bcm/y of send-out capacity and at least 180,000 m3 of LNG storage. Höegh Evi is consistently described as the FSRU/vessel provider and a co-developer/co-operator; no specific FSRU vessel has been publicly named for the terminal as of June 2026 (a reason GEM's FloatingVesselName and Operator fields are left blank rather than populated). VTTI's parents per GEM remain ADNOC, IFM Investors and Vitol Holding II SA.
